feature_contract.goal: Ensure the shipped DX9Ex test launcher starts and retries its actual OpenXR host with the same DirectGPU/desktop fallback and frame-cadence policy as the game test profile and the final GPU-Lab argument overrides.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: The shipping launcher reads host prewarm settings from OutRun2006Tweaks.ini even though it launches the game with profile-specific overrides. CONTROL has DirectGpuOnly=false and FrameCadenceMode=0 while CORRECTNESS enables DirectGpuOnly=true and uses XR cadence; INI defaults can differ from either.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only shipped DX9Ex test launcher prewarm/retry host environment. Preserve original game process, R84/R26_SAFE renderer, OpenXR host IPC protocol, fallback, score, SkyGlow and DX11/DXVK branches.
trace_stages: Game profile construction resolves effective command-line settings after GUI and GPU-Lab overrides.
Game's launcher prewarms x64 OpenXR host with inherited transport and cadence environment before launching 32-bit game.
On host disappearance or startup failure the bounded retry inherits identical environment and current-frame transport settings.
subcomponents: Parse all final game argument overrides into a case-insensitive PowerShell dictionary with last-argument precedence and INI fallback.
Use the shared resolved Get-VrRuntimeValue lookup for both prewarm and recovery host launches, including DirectGPU, desktop capture and cadence policy.
Extend the actual DX9Ex Active release launcher verifier with positive and in-memory negative mutation coverage.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: DX9Ex game launch profile to real OpenXR host prewarm
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All supported host-prewarm settings honor final game launch arguments over INI and defaults; last repeated command argument wins.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Host startup and bounded recovery after disappearance
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Prewarm and one bounded retry share the effective policy; original game is not killed; startup and recovery errors still reach logs.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: DX9Ex Active release launcher and x86/x64 game/host package
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Exact same result SHA passes Windows launcher/host/game/package and Domain Isolation gates; Quest3 remains separately UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Shipped Run-OutRunVRTest.ps1 applies final profile arguments to the game only; prewarm function looked exclusively in INI and fallback defaults.
diagnosis.root_cause: Prewarm policy read precedence did not honor CLI-profile effective settings, notably DirectGpuOnly and FrameCadenceMode.
source_trace: Get-OutRunVRTestProfile returns distinct CONTROL and CORRECTNESS settings.
Run-OutRunVRTest.ps1 builds final gameArgs but old Get-VrRuntimeValue ignores them.
Prewarm/recovery start x64 host with env from inconsistent INI/default values.
alternatives_rejected: Do not change host-owned OpenXR cadence or global setting defaults to paper over a launcher-only mismatch.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Resolved ordered final gameArgs before environment construction and used it for prewarm and retry.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Mutation verifier rejects ignoring overrides, dropped argument parsing, and broken assignment.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: DX9Ex host launch parity protects the already-implemented per-eye transport selection without modifying GPU draw or optical math.
